---
title: "scRNA Marker Identification and Export"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Identify markers between groups or clusters and export reusable marker tables.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/seurat_clustered.qs"
output_object <- "path/to/seurat_markers.qs"
results_dir <- "results/markers"
figures_dir <- "figures/markers"
assay_name <- "RNA"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
ident_column <- "seurat_clusters"
condition_1 <- "condition_1"
condition_2 <- "condition_2"
logfc_threshold <- 0.25
min_pct <- 0.1
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
object <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
DefaultAssay(object) <- assay_name
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(inherits(object, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column, ident_column) %in% colnames(object[[]])))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
group_counts <- object[[]] |> tibble::as_tibble() |> count(.data[[group_column]], name = "n_cells")
readr::write_tsv(group_counts, file.path(results_dir, "marker_group_counts.tsv"))
group_counts
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
Idents(object) <- object[[group_column, drop = TRUE]]
markers <- FindMarkers(
  object,
  ident.1 = condition_1,
  ident.2 = condition_2,
  logfc.threshold = logfc_threshold,
  min.pct = min_pct
) |> tibble::rownames_to_column("feature")
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
marker_summary <- markers |> summarise(n_markers = n(), n_adjusted_significant = sum(p_val_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE))
readr::write_tsv(marker_summary, file.path(results_dir, "marker_summary.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
top_features <- markers |> arrange(p_val_adj) |> slice_head(n = 12) |> pull(feature)
if (length(top_features) > 0) {
  pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "top_marker_dotplot.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5)
  print(DotPlot(object, features = top_features, group.by = group_column) + RotatedAxis())
  dev.off()
}
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$marker_identification <- list(group_column = group_column, condition_1 = condition_1, condition_2 = condition_2, n_markers = nrow(markers))
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(markers, file.path(results_dir, "markers_condition_1_vs_condition_2.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-05-marker-identification-and-export-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, marker_rows = nrow(markers))
```
